inputs.name: ResponseMessage
inputs.value: Please check the group name, type, capacity and compatible focus selections. Both profiles must be Active

equals:
@and(
  equals(body('Read_sender')?['Status']?['Value'], 'Active'),
  equals(body('Read_participant')?['Status']?['Value'], 'Active'),
  greater(length(trim(string(outputs('Group_name')))), 0),
  lessOrEquals(length(trim(string(outputs('Group_name')))), 255),
  contains(
    createArray(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10),
    outputs('Group_capacity')
  ),
  equals(
    length(intersection(
      body('Selected_languages'),
      outputs('Compatible_languages')
    )),
    length(body('Selected_languages'))
  ),
  equals(
    length(intersection(
      body('Selected_cultures'),
      outputs('Compatible_cultures')
    )),
    length(body('Selected_cultures'))
  ),
  or(
    and(
      equals(outputs('Group_type'), 'Language'),
      not(empty(body('Selected_languages'))),
      empty(body('Selected_cultures')),
      lessOrEquals(outputs('Group_capacity'), 3)
    ),
    and(
      equals(outputs('Group_type'), 'Culture'),
      empty(body('Selected_languages')),
      not(empty(body('Selected_cultures')))
    ),
    and(
      equals(outputs('Group_type'), 'Combined'),
      not(empty(body('Selected_languages'))),
      not(empty(body('Selected_cultures')))
    )
  )
)
